name: macro lifetime: from-import of one macro; it calls a sibling and reads a global and a library variable, called after the import statement

templates.lib.njk: {% set v = 'V' %}{% macro a() %}[{{ v }}{{ range(0,3) | join('') }}{{ b() }}{{ _helper() }}]{% endmacro %}{% macro b() %}b{% endmacro %}{% macro _helper() %}h{% endmacro %}

name: macro lifetime: import as namespace; library macros call a sibling and read a global

templates.lib.njk: {% set v = 'V' %}{% macro a() %}[{{ v }}{{ range(0,3) | join('') }}{{ b() }}{{ _helper() }}]{% endmacro %}{% macro b() %}b{% endmacro %}{% macro _helper() %}h{% endmacro %}
templates.main.njk: {% import 'lib.njk' as ns %}{{ ns.a() }}|{{ ns.b() }}|{{ ns.a() }}

name: macro lifetime: a library re-exports another library's macro through set; the macro reads outer names of its own library

templates.b.njk: {% macro m() %}{{ x }}<{{ v }}{{ range(0,2) | join(',') }}>{% endmacro %}{% set v = 'bv' %}
templates.a.njk: {% from 'b.njk' import m %}{% set g = m %}

name: macro lifetime: an import executed inside a macro body, the macro called several times

templates.lib.njk: {% set v = 'V' %}{% macro a() %}[{{ v }}{{ range(0,3) | join('') }}{{ b() }}]{% endmacro %}{% macro b() %}b{% endmacro %}
templates.main.njk: {% macro outer() %}{% from 'lib.njk' import a %}{{ a() }}{% endmacro %}{{ outer() }}{{ outer() }}{{ outer() }}

name: macro lifetime: a macro defined in a block, stored with set there and called after the block's own statements

templates.main.njk: {% block c %}{% macro m() %}{{ x }}{% endmacro %}{% set f = m %}{{ f() }}{{ m() }}{% endblock %}

name: macro lifetime: from-import with context inside a for loop; the macro reads a context name

templates.main.njk: {% for i in [1,2] %}{% from 'libx.njk' import m with context %}{{ m() }}{% endfor %}

name: macro lifetime: a macro that throws while called with a caller block

templates.main.njk: {% macro m() %}{{ caller() }}{{ nope() }}{% endmacro %}{% call m() %}c{% endcall %}
